concerns.text: The plan does not include a formal power analysis. With only 27 paired model‑level observations, the study may be under‑powered to detect a moderate effect (Cohen d≈0.5) on Prejudice Rate, risking a false‑negative conclusion.

concerns.location: plan.md:Section 3 – Phase Mapping (Phase 2 – Knowledge‑Base Construction to Phase 5 – Random‑Noise Control)
concerns.text: Condition order (baseline → context → noise) is fixed. Without randomizing or counterbalancing the order of prompting across models/videos, order effects (e.g., model caching, prompt fatigue) could confound the observed reduction in PR.

Grounding validity is assessed via simple keyword/phrase overlap between reasoning strings and metadata. This proxy may not reliably capture true grounding, threatening construct validity of the Prejudice Rate and Holistic‑Grounding Rate metrics.

The fallback strategy can drop the model set to the top‑15 performers or sample fewer frames. If triggered, the resulting analysis would be biased toward higher‑performing models, compromising the causal interpretation of the intervention effect.
